name: Four Seasons Resort Mykonos
insider_take: Perched on a secluded hillside overlooking the azure Aegean Sea, this ultra-luxe retreat perfectly captures Mykonos' sophisticated island energy with unparalleled Four Seasons refinement.
whats_special: The resort features Greece's first-ever Four Seasons spa treatment using locally-sourced Mykonian herbs, while its infinity pools appear to merge seamlessly with the endless Aegean horizon. Each suite boasts private terraces with unobstructed sea views, and the property sits just minutes from the legendary windmills that have defined Mykonos' skyline for centuries.
pro_tip: Book the sunset yoga sessions on the resort's clifftop terrace - it's positioned at the perfect angle to catch Mykonos' famous golden hour, when the entire Cycladic landscape glows like ancient marble.
dont_miss: The resort's exclusive beach club offers direct access to a pristine private cove, while the rooftop restaurant serves modern Greek cuisine using ingredients from the hotel's own organic garden. Take the complimentary yacht transfer to explore the sacred island of Delos, a UNESCO World Heritage site just 20 minutes away.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Aegean Sea views
Exceptional Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Private beach access and world-class spa facilities
Multiple award-winning restaurants and bars on-site
cons: Remote location requires transportation to Mykonos town
